purpose: Classify MCP surfaces and candidate MCP adoption paths by source, permissions, authentication, secrets, mutation risk, public-repo safety, SEIS value, priority, and required evidence.

runtimeSnapshot.sourceReportedEvidence: Local smoke contract reports stdio tools/list, resources/list, prompts/list, and bounded calls without remote MCP servers or credentials.

riskLevels.meaning: Local read/status surface with no secrets and no external mutation.
Local tool or prompt surface that can shape repo work and needs evidence before claims.
Credentialed, external, browser, package-runner, or mutation-capable surface requiring explicit approval and evidence.
Not allowed in public-safe SEIS without a separate owner-approved policy and verification path.

records.name: Local SEIS stdio MCP runtime
records.purpose: Expose local SEIS status, resources, prompts, and bounded smoke-test tools through stdio JSON-RPC.
records.seisValue: High value for local verification and source-of-truth resource reads.
requiredEvidence: local smoke test or direct checker output
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Keep stdio local, keys-free, and repo-backed. Do not add remote server calls in this class.

records.name: Repo-backed MCP resource reads
records.purpose: Read public-safe JSON resources for provider registry, plugin integration, model boundaries, subagent ledgers, and governance evidence.
records.seisValue: High value for traceable context assembly.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Resources must not expose local paths, provider keys, SSH credentials, or private notes.

records.name: Repo-backed MCP check tools
records.purpose: Run or represent bounded SEIS validation tools and status checks.
records.seisValue: High value for verification and governance loops.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Any tool that mutates files or external systems must move to a higher risk class.

records.name: Status and plan MCP tools
records.purpose: Expose lane status and plan outputs for SEIS hub, cloud, code, design, and data lanes.
records.seisValue: Useful for client-grade reporting and agent handoff.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Status tools must not claim CI, provider, deploy, or SSH success unless verified.

records.name: MCP prompt rendering
records.purpose: Render bounded audit, internationalization, and review prompts without embedding secrets.
records.seisValue: Useful for repeatable review and documentation prompts.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Prompt templates must not embed private conversation dumps or credentials.

records.name: Installed safe external MCP
records.purpose: Use already installed MCPs only when task relevance, auth state, safety scope, and validation path are explicit.
records.seisValue: Potentially useful for specialized tasks after verification.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Do not infer that an installed MCP is safe. Record the source, permissions, secrets, and mutation model first.

records.name: Candidate MCP ecosystem pool
records.purpose: Track possible MCPs for later review without activation.
records.seisValue: Useful for roadmap research but not runtime use.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Candidate MCPs must not be installed, enabled, or claimed available by this matrix.

records.name: Package-runner MCP
records.source: npm, uvx, pipx, docker, or similar runner
records.purpose: Start MCPs through package runners only after review because runner commands can fetch and execute code.
records.seisValue: Potential value depends on server, source, and auditability.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Do not approve blanket package-runner prefixes. Keep runner activation scoped and auditable.

records.name: Credentialed provider MCP
records.purpose: Connect to provider APIs only through secure, keys-free public repo configuration and explicit runtime auth.
records.seisValue: Useful for future live mode after backend isolation and owner auth.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Never store provider keys in frontend code, docs, examples, or public repo files.

records.name: External mutation MCP
records.source: issue trackers, repo hosts, docs platforms, databases, cloud services
records.purpose: Create, update, delete, deploy, send, schedule, or mutate external state.
records.seisValue: Potentially high after governance, auth, and rollback are documented.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: No external mutation may be hidden inside a broad automation step.

records.name: Browser automation MCP
records.purpose: Inspect or interact with browser surfaces for testing and research.
records.seisValue: Useful for UI smoke tests and browser validation after scope is constrained.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Avoid authenticated private pages unless the owner explicitly asks and secrets are protected.

records.name: SSH, cloud, and deploy MCP
records.purpose: Operate remote infrastructure, SSH sessions, deployments, or cloud resources.
records.seisValue: Useful only after SEIS-SSH and deployment runbooks are safe and verified.
records.safeConfigurationNotes: Never commit real hosts, private keys, passwords, or production deployment secrets.

qualityGates: Package runners are disabled or approval-gated.
Provider and SSH credentials stay outside public repo.
Failed checks must be reported honestly.
nextActions: Wire this checker into package scripts only after current package.json ownership is clear.
Map individual MCP candidates into the appropriate risk class during future registry expansion.
Keep official/provider-owned MCPs separate from community or package-runner candidates.
Add UI visibility only after the web demo scope is selected.
